editorialHolds.description: Crampon Psalms 89:4–5 uses modern numbered Psalms, while Douay/Clementine Latin Psalter has alternate numbering; an edition crosswalk is required.
Luke 3:36 includes Cainan; preserve the Luke source witness instead of silently conforming to Genesis 11.
Matthew's Solomonic and Luke's Nathan line must not be silently merged into one biological sequence.
No automatic identity assertion between the John named in Revelation and the son of Zebedee.
Greek additions in Esther and Daniel are retained and require edition-aware verse identifiers.
